JsonInspector

A JSON value as a collapsible tree: type-coloured values, sizes on arrays and objects, search that keeps the matching branches open, and copy buttons for the value and its path ($.request.headers["user-agent"]). Keyboard: the tree pattern, plus c copies the value and p the path of the focused row.

Source src/react/data/JsonInspector.tsx See it in the gallery

Example

Expand
  • request:{3 keys
  • method:"POST"
  • path:"/api/login"
  • headers:{2 keys
  • user-agent:"curl/8.4"
  • x-forwarded-for:"185.220.101.4"
  • score:72
  • findings:[2 items
  • 0:"tor-exit"
  • 1:"rate"
  • blocked:true
Scroll →
tsx 
import { JsonInspector } from "@osqd/ui"; <JsonInspector  defaultExpandDepth={2}  value={{    request: { method: "POST", path: "/api/login", headers: { "user-agent": "curl/8.4", "x-forwarded-for": "185.220.101.4" } },    score: 72,    findings: ["tor-exit", "rate"],    blocked: true,  }}/>

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescription
valuerequired unknown — —
defaultExpandDepth number 1 Levels open at first; 0 shows only the top level collapsed. Default 1.
showRoot boolean false Show the value itself as a $ row instead of starting at its children.
toolbar boolean true Search box and depth buttons. Default true.
pageSize number 100 Children shown per array or object before "Show more". Default 100.
maxHeight number — Max height of the tree in px; it scrolls past that.
onCopy (kind: "value" | "path", text: string) => void — Called after a value or path is copied.

Also accepts every native <div> attribute, passed through to the root element.
